items.title: FedEx (FDX) Stock Still Looks Below Fair Value After 78% Rally
items.summary: FedEx stock has rallied strongly over the past year, yet several valuation checks still point to room between the current share price and an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach. With both the DCF intrinsic value and market multiple checks suggesting the stock leans toward undervalued territory, investors are weighing how much of the recent optimism is already reflected in the price. items.title: FedEx (FDX) Faces New Lawsuit Over Truck Crash Allegations
items.summary: FedEx (NYSE:FDX) is facing a new lawsuit after a major collision in which a company truck driver allegedly fell asleep at the wheel, causing catastrophic injuries to the plaintiff. The complaint claims serious operational failures in FedEx's driver oversight and safety practices that, according to the filing, contributed to the crash.
